principles.name: One register, few voices
principles.tradition: T Magazine (NYT Style Magazine) custom type program
principles.principle: A publication earns coherence by casting a tiny family of typographic voices (one display, one accent, one utility) and letting that cast play every role on every page instead of inventing new styles per surface.
principles.application: The locked trio is already the cast; enforce the casting everywhere: Fraunces editorialEyebrow (11pt tracked caps) for every section mark, JeniHeroSerif for every claim, DMSans for every fact. Rebuild hybrid lines like Home's '860 of ~1,473 today · room for ~600' (four styles sharing one line) into the onboarding snap-receipt grammar: one cocoa serif numeral, one small italic unit, one sans fact line below.

principles.name: Hierarchy by air, not weight
principles.principle: When type sizes stay quiet and uniform, importance is signaled by the negative space granted around an element, so hierarchy lives between the blocks rather than inside them.
principles.application: Keep Becoming's HER SIGNALS index rows at one serif size and open its section bands with Space.section (36pt+) of cream instead of bolding or enlarging; on Home, grant the single verb headline ('snap the next plate') a 40pt air moat above and below while steps and hints shrink to caption ledger rows instead of competing registers.

principles.name: Hairlines, never boxes
principles.principle: Editorial pages draw structure with 1px rules and shared alignments; cards, borders, and filled containers are admissions that the grid failed.
principles.application: Extend the act-end receipt grammar (tiny left label, right-aligned serif value, hairlineCocoa rule) to every utility row: Home's steps row, the cycle hint, and each care-checklist item become ledger lines directly on cream with trailing state words ('still open', 'kept'). The bordered 'connect' banner collapses to one caption line with a rose text link; elevated cards are reserved for sheets.

principles.name: Ma, the pause is content
principles.principle: Deliberate emptiness placed after a statement is not unused space but the room where the statement resonates; a screen that says one thing should be mostly blank.
principles.application: The letter moment's vast cream field between 'jeni ♥' and the reply pill is the model; protect it. On Home, refuse to backfill the lower half with hints or tiles: end the composition after the numeral band and let cream run to the tab bar, exactly as onboarding beat 10 ends after one sub-line and holds silence to the CTA.

principles.name: One idea per screenful
principles.principle: Each viewport-height presents exactly one claim in display type with one supporting line, and the next idea waits below the fold instead of sharing the screen.
principles.application: The insights carousel already obeys (one claim, one visual, one folio per page). Bring Home into obedience: morning is one verb headline plus one numeral band; evening close is the CLOSING THE DAY ledger alone, with the feelings chips and tonight's plan arriving as separate scroll beats parted by Space.section air, never stacked in one view.

principles.name: The number is the image
principles.tradition: Didone magazine numerals + Apple data pacing
principles.principle: When a metric is the point, set it at display scale in the serif with its unit whispered in small italics; a confident numeral on an empty ground outperforms any gauge, ring, or bar.
principles.application: Home's calorie moment becomes a numeralHero-scale '860' with italic 'of ~1,473' trailing, the grammar the onboarding snap demo already signed with '500 calories ± 75'. The weight triptych (165.3 STARTED, 163.6 NOW, 143.3 GOAL) stays serif numeral plus tracked statLabel. No rings or progress bars anywhere on cream.

principles.name: Restraint protects the price
principles.principle: Near-zero visual noise on a disciplined monochrome ground is what makes premium positioning believable, because every decorative extra reads as an apology for the product.
principles.application: Cocoa on cream is the resting state of every screen; rose #C4677A appears at most once per screenful and only as meaning (the cycle sentence, the trend endpoint dot, one punch word), never as decoration. Audit Home's camera disc, the hint pill, and chat's pink bubbles so the accent's single appearance lands the way Aesop lands its one yellow.

principles.name: Utility never breaks the atmosphere
principles.principle: Functional controls are folded quietly into the composition, one integrated bar and small dark marks, so the mood is never interrupted by machinery.
principles.application: One cocoa pill per screen is the only filled control ('reply', 'show me', 'continue'). The daily care checklist keeps the row-tap law with a render-only trailing state word instead of a leading radio circle, so the list reads like an itinerary at Aman rather than a to-do app; camera and menu stay small, dark, corner-anchored.

principles.name: Meditative pacing, one motion per beat
principles.principle: Content arrives in slow sequenced beats with stillness between them, and each beat animates exactly one element while everything else holds.
principles.application: Per visit, Home's bands (dateline, reading, numeral, ledger) fade up once in sequence and then hold still; carousel pages re-arm exactly one visual per swipe (already built). Never let the dawn arc, a count-up numeral, and a chip shimmer move within the same still.

principles.name: Strict grid, one improvisation
principles.principle: A rigid margin-and-column skeleton held identically everywhere is precisely what lets a single off-axis element, an italic word or an accent, feel alive instead of messy.
principles.application: One shared left margin (24pt screenPadding) aligns every eyebrow, headline, ledger label, and hairline from onboarding beat 03 through Home, Becoming, and chat; right alignment is reserved for ledger values and the italic 'monday' folio; the single italic serif punch word remains the one sanctioned improvisation per screen.

principles.name: Lagom, warmth from material not addition
principles.principle: Warmth is carried by material, tone, and rounded form rather than by adding elements, so just-right density means deleting the helper layer and trusting the palette.
principles.application: Cream ground, the rounded cocoa pill, terminal hearts, and the lowercase voice already carry the warmth; delete third-level captions ('counted for you' folds into the steps ledger row as a trailing caption) and resist adding tiles to cozy up Home's empty lower half. Fewer objects, each with a purpose.

principles.name: Folio furniture binds the book
principles.tradition: Magazine print furniture (folios, datelines, section marks)
principles.principle: Tiny fixed rituals, an issue date, a page number, a section mark, repeated in identical positions make disparate screens feel like pages of one publication.
principles.application: Standardize the furniture set: tracked-caps eyebrow top-left on every surface, the 'MONDAY, JULY 27' dateline in identical spec on Home and Becoming, the JENI hairline-to-italic-'monday' dateline on letters, and the roman folio 'i · of xii' bottom-center in romanOrnament on every carousel page. Same position, same size, every issue.

principles.name: One ask per beat
principles.principle: Confidence accrues when each beat asks or shows exactly one thing, so two questions on one screen always cost more than two screens.
principles.application: Evening close currently stacks a feelings chip row, a tonight-plan chip row, and a checklist item in one screenful. Sequence it: the ledger closes the day; one chip family per scroll beat; tonight's plan compresses to a single ledger row (the 'tomorrow: a balanced day' row already models this) unless she opens it.
